incident-bot: PAGED: P1 Incident #INC-4821 — Service: inference-hosting — 503 spike across west-1. Pager triggered at 19:12 UTC. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-4821 :rotating_light:
Priya Patel: I'm on evening handoff, just saw the pager while reviewing metrics. Taking initial triage.
Liam Chen: On call here, 3 min to join the bridge. Priya — any customer-facing comms yet?
Priya Patel: Not yet. I checked console — error rate up from 0.2% to 12% over last 5m. Per-route latency stable. Suspect autoscaler flapping. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/503-spike
Priya Patel: Steps I'm doing: 1) check pods in west-1, 2) drain unhealthy instance if needed, 3) validate KV cache.
Liam Chen: OK I'll be primary driver. Priya, can you take comms? Need someone to ack the page and post a short customer note in #customer-impact.
Priya Patel: I can take comms. Posting in #customer-impact now. /me posts: 'We are investigating increased 503s in west-1, engineers on it. ETA 30min.' :speech_balloon:
Jordan Reyes: Jumping in for extra hands. Which autoscaler? HPA or custom scheduler?
Priya Patel: HPA on inference-pool-west1. Logs show OOMKill on gpu-worker-7-... I'm pulling pod logs: 
Priya Patel: ```kubectl -n inference logs gpu-worker-7-abc123 --previous``` -> repeated oom-kill, high mem alloc
Liam Chen: That matches — looks like a bad rollout. I'm going to pin traffic to previous replica set and scale down the new one. Command: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-worker --to-revision=42```
Liam Chen: Executed. Scaling old RS to 12 replicas, draining new pods.
incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-4821
Priya Patel: Posted update: 'Applied rollback to stable release, scaling to restore capacity. Monitoring for error rate drop.'
Jordan Reyes: Watching metrics — error rate dropping to 6% and falling. Nice.
Liam Chen: I'll stay on as the driver for the next 20m while Priya handles comms. If it continues to degrade, escalate to infra team.
Priya Patel: Copy. I'll update every 10m. Assigned: Driver=Liam Chen, Comms=Priya Patel. Handing over now — Liam, take the bridge lead.
Liam Chen: Taking lead. Noted owner assignment in incident tracker: driver=lchen, comms=ppatel. I'll annotate runbook with rollback step.
Priya Patel: Thanks — marking handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident assigned — driver:lchen, comms:ppatel, responders:[jreyes]. Last update at 19:14 UTC.
